name: magnetic-repel-field
title: Magnetic Repel Field
description: The anti-magnet: grid tiles flee the pointer with force proportional to proximity, then spring back with damped oscillation — a field of objects that keeps its shape only when you leave it alone.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Pointer Repel: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
